assets.name: background
assets.prompt: Create a polished storybook game background, landscape 1536x1024. Painterly premium board-game art. Calm central area for interface, intricate floral details on left and right. No text, no symbols, no numbers, no UI.

assets.name: button
assets.prompt: Create one premium fantasy game button on transparent background, wide horizontal 5:1 shape centered and filling most canvas.
